program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points}
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - max(dr for dr, dc in shape)):
        for c in range(w - max(dc for dr, dc in shape)):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
